Local landscaping

Landscaping in Oran Park, from bare block to finished yard

Almost every job in Oran Park starts the same way: a new home, a bare block, estate design guidelines to meet and a landscaping bond hanging over it. We take that off your plate with a turnkey package, front and back, built to the guidelines so you clear the bond and get a yard you actually want to use.

One licensed local team does the design, turf, paving, beds and retaining together, quotes a fixed price after seeing the block, and never charges a call-out fee.

Get your fixed-price quote

Our services

Everything your Oran Park outdoor space needs, under one licence

Landscape design

Concept plans, planting schemes and clear drawings you can build from, including council-ready plans where a project needs them.

Learn more

Paving

Patios, paths and driveways laid on properly prepared bases so they don't lift, dip or crack when the clay moves.

Learn more

Retaining walls

Engineered walls with real drainage behind them. On a sloping block, that's what keeps soil and structures where they belong.

Learn more

Turf laying

Fresh lawn on a graded, conditioned base, with the right turf variety for our heat and frost swings so it takes and stays green.

Learn more

Gardening & planting

Garden beds, hedges and planting chosen for local conditions, plus tidy-ups that bring a tired yard back to life.

Learn more

Mulching

Quality mulch that locks in moisture through a dry western Sydney summer and keeps weeds down between seasons.

Learn more

Tree removal

Safe removal and clearing to open up a block or make way for a new design, with the mess taken away.

Learn more

Weeding

Thorough weeding and green-waste removal that resets an overgrown yard and keeps it manageable.

Why Oran Park is different

Built for Oran Park new-estate blocks

Landscaping bond, cleared

We build front and back to your estate's design guidelines and bond conditions, so you meet the deadline and get your bond back without the stress.

Turnkey packages

Turf, garden beds, paving, edging and a tidy frontage in one coordinated job, planned so levels and drainage suit the planting from day one.

New-build clay and fill

Fresh estate blocks are often cut, filled and compacted clay. We prep the ground properly so turf takes and paving stays put.

props.label: Section
props.html:
FAQs

Landscaping in Oran Park: your questions answered

Can you meet the Oran Park estate design guidelines and bond deadline?
Yes. Turnkey new-estate landscaping is a core part of what we do. We build front and back to the guidelines and bond conditions so you clear the requirement and get a finished yard on time.
How long does a new Oran Park yard take?
A turnkey front and back package usually runs from a few days to a couple of weeks depending on size, access and weather. You get a clear timeline with your fixed quote.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How soon can you start?
Often quickly, especially for smaller jobs and quotes. We are open 7am to 7pm, 7 days, so call 0451 267 287 and we will tell you honestly what we can do.
